conclusion: CPU and GPU preflight passed for all three interfaces. Existing getup and walk deliveries remain accepted and are reused; only roll enters a new paired learner because the shared-support diagnosis identified a specific airborne rotation loss.

skills.name: getup
skills.first_action: reuse the accepted getup delivery; reopen learning only with a new evidence-backed gap
skills.gate: four requested release strata and three-second stable hold

skills.name: roll
skills.first_action: run the frozen matched control/candidate airborne-support pilot, then independent 128-episode roll evaluation
skills.gate: official forward-roll completion, contact order, two-second landing hold

skills.name: walk
skills.first_action: reuse the accepted walking delivery; reopen learning only with a new evidence-backed gap
skills.gate: stand, forward, backward, both turns and both strafes at the original 32x20 s thresholds

skills.name: router
skills.first_action: only after all three independent skills pass, run getup-to-stand-to-walk and roll-to-stand-to-walk transitions with no physical reset
skills.gate: continuous transition traces and held-out command screen

resource_policy.backend: Ubuntu-24.04 WSL CUDA; native Ubuntu comparison only if measured net throughput is higher
resource_policy.training_env_scale: start at the last verified zero-step scale for each task; double only after memory and host throughput checks
resource_policy.media: keep periodic complete clips, update JSONL metrics every update, no continuous renderer window
stop_on: new gate regression relative to paired control

next_gate: Review the failed roll candidate and freeze a distinct mechanism protocol before any additional learning; router remains blocked.
router_blocked_until: roll candidate or a future roll candidate must independently pass the original roll gate
